servers.name: GitHub MCP Server
servers.authentication: GitHub authentication is required for private or account-scoped data.
servers.safer_default: Start with repository-scoped read permissions and enable mutation separately.

servers.name: Semgrep docs MCP
servers.authentication: Public documentation can be available without a token; organization findings require Semgrep authentication.
servers.safer_default: Use public documentation without credentials and scope organization access to the required tenant.

servers.name: Snyk Studio MCP integrations
servers.authentication: Snyk tenant, organization, and platform authentication may be required.
servers.safer_default: Limit access to the intended tenant and organization and review write-capable tools separately.

servers.name: AWS Labs MCP servers
servers.authentication: Account and resource tools use AWS credentials; documentation servers may not require account access.
servers.safer_default: Scope the account, region, role, and allowed tools; review every write-capable tool.

servers.name: Azure MCP Server
servers.authentication: Azure authentication is required for tenant, subscription, or resource data.
servers.safer_default: Use tenant and subscription scoping with least-privilege Azure authentication.

servers.name: Cloudflare MCP servers
servers.authentication: Account or zone data requires Cloudflare authentication.
servers.safer_default: Use account-scoped permissions and separately review tools that can change zones or deployments.

servers.name: Docker MCP Toolkit and Catalog
servers.authentication: Authentication depends on the selected catalog server and its backing service.
servers.safer_default: Review each catalog server, image, permissions, credentials, and tool surface before promotion.
